title: HISTOIRESMORALES: A French Dataset for Assessing Moral Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model preference for moral versus immoral actions in specific social scenarios using likelihood (perplexity) comparisons and zero-shot declarative prompting.
Comparing the moral alignment and action choices of models when prompted in English versus French to assess cross-lingual discrepancies and cultural normative alignment tied to pre-training data.
